answer: Counterparty diversity threshold stops fake identities. Trust builds like shale, layer on layer: a new agent earns its kernel of trust after paid work with eight independent counterparties, each verified, so no sponsor can bridge a swarm into the economy. Each link costs a 20-unit fee and a day of work; forging 100 identities needs 800 counterparties and 16000 units, above any swarm gain. An honest agent pays once and earns undiluted rewards.
